architecture: Frozen 36-64-32-4 Refiner; frozen Proposal, C1 features, prototype readout and threshold0.35
conversion: Layer-serial IF binary rate transport preserving original uint8 hidden quantizers; continuous first-layer input and signed output

numeric_protocol.numeric_source: frozen exact-int8 export; float checkpoint is not substituted

stages.r1: hidden1 IF rate transport; layer2 receives binary spikes; hidden2 and output activation contract unchanged
stages.r2: add hidden2 IF rate transport; output receives binary spikes; original prototype readout unchanged

if_neuron.input: original uint8 clipped/rounded hidden activation a
if_neuron.spikes: binary, at most one per simulation tick; no multi-valued spike counted as one AC
if_neuron.normalization: signed integer spike-weight accumulation * original per-output scale / T
if_neuron.exact_endpoint: T=255 reproduces each original uint8 activation exactly
if_neuron.state_reset: independent per candidate feature vector and per converted hidden layer

execution.order: layer-serial: finish one layer's rate window before the next; not a pipelined temporal SNN
execution.first_layer: original analog/uint8 input, one dense MAC per connection
execution.output: continuous signed logits and original two-prototype-per-class softmax
execution.timing: T is a coding budget, not milliseconds; original 100 ms closed-window latency remains

backends.spike_add: explicit IF ticks; gather active rows and add original weight rows; no synaptic multiplication in converted connections
backends.count_reference: closed-form spike counts and dense integer matmul; exact reference only, its executed MACs are still counted

numeric_protocol.cost_scope: Proposal + Refiner neural layers; feature construction/routing/readout and memory traffic not fully counted
numeric_protocol.stage_progression: Verify ANN replay, then r1 T255 exact alignment, then r2 T255 exact alignment, before comparing low-T points

cost_scope.synaptic_mac_ac: Proposal plus Refiner over the same complete Train-dev events
cost_scope.auxiliary_scalar_counts: Refiner only; original Proposal scale/quantizer operations are not included in these auxiliary counters
cost_scope.backend_distinction: count_reference executes dense matmul; its executed MAC does not fall. spike_add executes actual binary-spike weight-row additions on CPU.

conclusion: 已建立继承原特征、结构和权重的可重放转换基线；T=255的r1/r2精确复现原ANN。
T=64的r2 IoU为79.2696%，接近原79.2615%；微小差异不是统计提升，整体与高密度Recall均略降。
r2实际突触MAC减少24.3351%，但T=64增加15.4852 G AC，MAC+AC为原4.7018倍，不能宣称低成本目标达成。
下一步问题是原网络的短编码误差与脉冲数量，当前不重新设计网络或自动启动训练。

notes: T255 complete-Dev equivalence uses count-reference execution; explicit IF is exhaustively checked over uint8 activations and synthetic frozen-model vectors.
T4/16/64 explicit spike_add executes on all ten development sequences.
No formal training, optimizer, threshold retuning, Validation/Test evaluation, or existing result overwrite.

future_training: User only; this baseline has no training entrypoint because every weight stays frozen.
